sources.label: morphe patches for the cracked apps from PDALIFE to remove the annoying popups
sources.author: PDALIFE Banner Remover
patch_list: Universal patch: Patches libPDALIFE.so's JNI_OnLoad to return immediately without installing hooks. Prevents PDALIFE banner/toast from being set up.
Removes android:name="com.pdalife.PdaApplication" from AndroidManifest.xml so the PDALIFE injector never runs.
Deletes assets/PDALIFE.conf and assets/PDALIFE.bin from the APK. Keeps libPDALIFE.so so native onCreate methods resolve.
